configurationFields.label: Server Start Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the server start mode: Start the server with the specified Save File; or Start the server with the latest save file; or Start the server with a new save with the specified Save File name

configurationFields.label: Save File
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the save file in the 'saves' directory to load on server start, if applicable to the Server Start Mode. If the file does not exist, it will be created. It will be overwritten if 'Create and start server' is the Server Start Mode

configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server as it will appear in the game listing

configurationFields.label: Serverbeschreibung
configurationFields.description: Sets the description of the server as it will appear in the game listing. [Rich text formatting](https://wiki.factorio.com/Rich_text) and newlines are permitted

configurationFields.label: Server Tags
configurationFields.description: Sets a list of tags for the server that will appear in the game listing

configurationFields.label: Server Admins
configurationFields.description: A list of usernames for server admins can be configured in 'server-adminlist.json'. Must be in valid JSON format: ["Admin1","Admin2"]

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time. Admins can still join a full server, as can returning players if Ignore Player Limit For Returning Players is enabled. 0 = unlimited

configurationFields.label: Ignore Player Limit For Returning Players
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players that have played on this map already can join even when the Player Limit is reached

configurationFields.label: Make Server Visible Publicly
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will be published on the official Factorio matching server. Requires the Factorio.com Username and either Factorio.com Password or Factorio.com Auth Token to be set

configurationFields.label: Make Server Visible On LAN
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will be broadcast on LAN

configurationFields.label: Factorio.com Username
configurationFields.description: Sets the factorio.com login username for the server owner. Required for the server to be visible publicly

configurationFields.label: Factorio.com Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the factorio.com login password for the server owner. Required for the server to be visible publicly. Alternatively set the Factorio.com Auth Token

configurationFields.label: Factorio.com Auth Token
configurationFields.description: Sets the factorio.com authentication token for the server owner. Required for the server to be visible publicly. Alternatively set the Factorio.com Password

configurationFields.label: Game Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Require User Verification
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allow clients that have a valid Factorio.com account will be allowed to connect to the server

configurationFields.label: Use Server Whitelist
configurationFields.description: If enabled, only whitelisted players can connect. The whitelist can be configured in 'data/server-whitelist.json'. Must be in valid JSON format: ["Player1","Player2"]

configurationFields.label: Use Auth Server Bans
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will verify that connecting players are not banned from multiplayer and inform Factorio.com about ban/unban commands

configurationFields.label: Maximum Upload Speed
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum upload speed. 0 = unlimited

configurationFields.label: Maximum Upload Slots
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of upload slots. 0 = unlimited

configurationFields.label: Minimum Latency
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum latency allowed for clients (one tick is 16ms). 0 = no minimum

configurationFields.label: Maximum Heartbeats
configurationFields.description: Sets the network tick rate, being the maximum rate game update packets are sent at before bundling them together

configurationFields.label: Commands Permission Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the permission level for allowing commands to be run by clients on the server

configurationFields.label: Autosave Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the server autosave interval

configurationFields.label: Autosave Slots
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of server autosave slots, cycled through when the server autosaves

configurationFields.label: AFK Autokick Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the period until someone is kicked when doing nothing. 0 = never kick

configurationFields.label: Enable Auto Pause
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will be paused when no players are present

configurationFields.label: Auto Pause When Players Connect
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will be paused when a player is connecting to the server

configurationFields.label: Only Admins Can Pause
configurationFields.description: If enabled, only admins will be able to pause the server

configurationFields.label: Enable Autosave Only On Server
configurationFields.description: If enabled, autosaves will be saved only on the server. Otherwise, they will also be saved on all connected clients

configurationFields.label: Enable Non-Blocking Saving
configurationFields.description: Highly experimental feature. Enable only at your own risk of losing saves. On Linux systems, the server will fork itself to create an autosave. Autosaving on connected Windows clients will be disabled regardless of Enable Autosave Only On Server

configurationFields.label: Minimum Segment Size
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum segment size for long network messages. Increasing the segment size will increase upload bandwidth requirement for the server and download bandwidth requirement for clients

configurationFields.label: Minimum Segment Size Peer Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of peers required for the minimum segment size

configurationFields.label: Maximum Segment Size
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum segment size for long network messages. Increasing the segment size will increase upload bandwidth requirement for the server and download bandwidth requirement for clients

configurationFields.label: Maximum Segment Size Peer Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of peers required for the maximum segment size

configurationFields.label: Custom Command Line Arguments
configurationFields.description: Sets custom [command line arguments](https://wiki.factorio.com/Command_line_parameters) for the server. Don't use options already in GSCS's settings!

configurationFields.label: Install Beta Branch
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows beta branches (branches other than the 'public' or stable branch) to be installed. Specify the branch under Selected Beta Branch. Update the server after switching branches

configurationFields.label: Selected Beta Branch
configurationFields.description: Sets the [beta branch](https://steamdb.info/app/427520/depots/) to install. Requires Install Beta Branch to be enabled. Set any required password under Beta Password. Update the server after switching branches

deploymentSteps.name: Create Save
deploymentSteps.arguments: /C cd server & if not exist "saves\{SAVEFILE}" ( .\bin\x64\factorio.exe --create saves\{SAVEFILE} --map-gen-settings data\map-gen-settings.json --map-settings data\map-settings.json )

authenticationRequirements.label: Steam-Konto
authenticationRequirements.description: Ein Steam-Konto mit Berechtigung für dieses Spiel hinterlegen. Steam Guard kann einmalig erforderlich sein.

authenticationRequirements.label: Öffentliche Serverliste
authenticationRequirements.description: Für die öffentliche Serverliste einen Factorio-Benutzernamen und ein Token oder Passwort hinterlegen. Ein privater Linux-Server benötigt kein Steam-Konto.
